Settings.NoSpeechThresholdDescription: 0.0 to 1.0. Segments whose no-speech probability exceeds this value are dropped so silent gaps don't get transcribed as hallucinated phrases (commonly "Thank you."). Lower = more aggressive filtering. Default 0.6 matches whisper.cpp's own default. Leave blank to use the default.
Settings.ThresholdInvalid: No-speech threshold must be a number between 0.0 and 1.0.
